title: Prevention programs

draft.title: Prevention programs
card: A prevention program is an organised effort to stop a non-infectious disease from developing, or to catch it early when it is easier to treat.
a program that changes behaviours or conditions that raise the chance of disease. The SunSmart campaign in Australia teaches people to use shade, hats, clothing and sunscreen to cut skin cancer risk.
testing people who may have no symptoms, so disease is found early. BreastScreen Australia uses mammograms to look for breast cancer in this way.
Finding disease early often gives more treatment options. Cutting risk factors can lower the number of new cases, so both can reduce illness and death in a population.
draft.remember: Prevention programs either cut risk factors or find disease early, so fewer people become seriously ill.

a.q: Which action is an example of screening?
opts: Testing people with no symptoms to find disease early
Telling people to wear a hat and use shade outdoors
Giving a treatment to a patient with advanced disease
Counting how many people have died from a disease
a.why: Screening tests people who feel well so that disease is found early. Telling people to wear hats is tempting, but it aims to cut a risk factor, not to find disease that is already present.
a.clue: Screening looks for disease in people who feel well.

b.q: A council in Cairns runs a campaign urging outdoor workers to wear long sleeves and sunscreen. Which aim does this campaign mainly serve?
opts: Cutting a risk factor for skin cancer
Finding skin cancer early in people without symptoms
Measuring how many people have skin cancer
Treating skin cancer that has already spread
b.why: Long sleeves and sunscreen reduce exposure to UV radiation, a risk factor for skin cancer. Finding disease early is tempting because the campaign is about skin cancer, but nothing in it tests people for existing cancer.
b.clue: Ask whether the campaign tests people or changes what they do.

a.best: Testing people with no symptoms to find disease early

b.best: Cutting a risk factor for skin cancer
